options: By rubbing two large plastic sheets together to generate static electricity.
By spinning coils of wire in an electric generator.
By chemical reactions between acid and metal plates inside the turbine.
By compressing air until it sparks and produces electricity directly.

questions.question: How do solar panels differ from wind turbines and hydroelectric systems in how they produce electricity?
options: They produce electricity directly from sunlight without using electric generators.
They use steam instead of water to spin miniature generators inside each cell.
They require a small internal combustion engine to start the electrical flow.
They rely on spinning coils of wire powered by light waves rather than physical wind.
